work.title: C03 — Durable checkpoint and cross-provider handover
work.description: At checkpoints write a task worktree/branch plus a handoff note (requirements, investigation so far, decisions, current status, next steps) in a provider-neutral format; `resume --with <cli>` re-launches an interrupted task in another official CLI or a local model from the note and repository state (pattern evidenced by Flock PR #3 and Tutti handoff packets). Conversation state is not transferred.
work.acceptance_criteria: Ten real or rehearsed handovers measured: fraction of work redone, whether the resumed run completed, reviewer acceptance; handoff note format documented; tests for note generation and resume. Continue if median rework ≤30%; otherwise narrow to checkpoint-only (no automatic resume).
